Lotus Root 12.5.3 · 20 Nov 2026

Forks and reorgs, recorded and shown

⬇ Download 12.5.3What is newQuick start
ImportantNapoleon, 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC: every node must run 12.5.1 or later before then. This version qualifies. Earlier versions, 12.4.x included, do not follow the chain after the fork.

Highlights

  • Forks and reorgs, recorded and shown. The node keeps a history of reorganisations, orphaned and held blocks, side branches and parked chains, and groups them into episodes. A new Network page shows them live and over time, with the blocks each side won and lost.
  • Up-to-date node documentation. The documentation served by the node now uses this release in its examples and walks through the upgrade to 12.5.x, the Napoleon requirement included.

Compatibility and rollback

Minimum version on the network12.5.1, required from Napoleon (2026-12-21 20:50 UTC)
NapoleonEvery node must run 12.5.1 or later before 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC. This version qualifies.
UpgradingStop the node, replace the binaries, start it. The data directory is kept.
Going backStop the node and put the previous binaries back. Going back is not always possible once a newer version has written to the data directory; the release says when.

Install and verify

Docker 
docker pull ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.5.3
docker run -d --name lotusd -v lotus-data:/data ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.5.3
Linux 
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.5.3/SHA256SUMS
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.5.3/lotus-binaries-12.5.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS     # must print: OK
tar -xzf lotus-binaries-12.5.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
./lotus-binaries-12.5.3-linux-x86_64/lotusd -version
macOS

The same steps with lotus-binaries-12.5.3-macos-x86_64.tar.gz; check with shasum -a 256 -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS. macOS asks for confirmation before the first launch (the binaries are not notarised).

Windows

Download lotus-binaries-12.5.3-windows-x86_64.zip and SHA256SUMS. In PowerShell, Get-FileHash .\lotus-binaries-12.5.3-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256 must give the value on that file's line. Then unzip.

Download Lotus binaries from github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases only, and check them against SHA256SUMS.
